name: Air65 Analog: VCI 0702 PRO DB 30000 KV, Gemfan 1219 3-blade 31 mm, weBLEEDfpv 340 mAh 1S BT2.0

sources.S: quadmath de9b15d script.js (calculator: motorDB, propDB, packs, models)
sources.derive: scripts/derive-air65.mjs runs quadmath's own functions (physicsFromBuild, aeroCoeffs, whoopScale, whoopGroundK) on BUILD_PRESETS.air65 (B:79-86) and prints these literals
sources.WebFPV: WebFPV at 518846c, read for published facts only (the project rule: read theirs freely, never paste)
sources.HV: tests/reference/air65-hover.json: the owner's bench hover on this Air65 with blackbox (Betaflight 4.5.0, 2026-10-23, window 3-59 s of 66.1 s)

confidence: high: measured on this quad. medium: quadmath data for this build, or a quadmath class rule. low: a quadmath sim or calculator constant tuned for feel, or scaled from a class reference; no first-hand measurement exists (PROGRESS.md 2026-10-22 decisions, finding 5).

mass.source: HV measured.auw_g 25.79: all-up weight, props on, with the weBLEEDfpv 340 mAh 1S BT2.0 pack the hover was flown on (owner, 2026-10-23)
mass.note: replaces the bench file's 25.42 g (AJ:11, on its LAVA 300 mAh pack); the pack values are this pack's (capacityMah, cellIR, iRef, iRefDuty), except the OCV table (quadmath's LiPo table)

wheelbase.source: AJ:5 frame_size_mm 65, used as the motor-to-motor diagonal as quadmath does (QP:8, B:198)
wheelbase.note: the bench file has no motor spacing

boxHeightRatio.source: QP:434-440 flat-box inertia, h = 0.35 x wheelbase
boxHeightRatio.note: no measured inertia: ixx, iyy and izz (plant.c derive(), a solid box) are awaiting a pendulum measurement (owner, 2026-10-24); left at 0.35 until then

kv.source: AJ:8 motor_kv; motorDB S:96 'VCI 0702 PRO DB' kv 30000
kv.note: the tune card's motor is the VCI Spark 0702 29K (tune-database.js:69), a different motor (S:90-95)

vRefCell.source: B:213 batteryFromBuild full = 4.2 x cells: the pack voltage at which quadmath's thrust (tmax) holds
vRefCell.note: the weBLEEDfpv BT2.0 pack is rested at 4.24 V under 0.62 A before take-off (HV idle_prearm_bin0); its chemistry and full voltage are not recorded

loadFraction.source: owner decision 2026-10-23 (round 4): the plant's one constant winding resistance cannot meet both the bench hover and the punch; at 0.62 the plant as landed (with iQuiescent and currentExponent 2.60) hovers at stick 0.375 (bench 0.371, tests/reference/air65-hover.json; gate-plant's X3 hover-stick row) and spins 65,234 rpm at the punch's plateau duty from a full pack, 3.554 V / 19.79 A (log 63,810 rpm, 3.504 V / 19.06 A, tests/reference/air65-punch.json; gate-plant P8), within about 2 % of both (PROGRESS.md 2026-10-23: the loadFraction scan, made before the quiescent current, gave 0.374 and 65,248). Measured at full in the punch log: 64400 / (30000 x 3.56 x 0.93) = 0.648 (owner), 0.6562 by the tool's steady plateau
loadFraction.note: the plant takes loadFraction as its static full-throttle point at vRefCell (src/plant/plant.c derive()); the punch ran at duty 0.93 and 3.5 V, below that point, so the plant's own ratio there is not the measured one (PROGRESS.md 2026-10-23). Replaces 0.65 (measured at full), which replaced 0.632 (the fit to the hover ratio)

tmax.source: HV: the measured thrust coefficient kt = m g / (4 w_hover^2) = 0.02579 x 9.81 / (4 x 3389^2) = 5.5070e-9 N/(rad/s)^2 (w_hover from the logged eRPM: Betaflight 4.5.1 drivers/dshot.c:56, :183, :395-399, blackbox/blackbox.c:261, :1170), times w_full^2 = (loadFraction x KV x vRefCell)^2 = 8180.7^2 rad/s. The punch log confirms kt: at its plateau rpm it predicts 3.887 g at onset against 3.85 g measured (gate-plant P6)
tmax.note: the plant derives kt = tmax / w_full^2, so this value carries the measured kt; re-derive it whenever loadFraction, KV or vRefCell change (tools/hover-from-log.mjs prints it). As a full thrust at 4.2 V: T/W 5.83, not measured. quadmath's class reference was 0.478 N (B:168-209)

kqRatio.source: derive: physicsFromBuild kQ (B:186); QP:21, QP:305 yaw torque = kQ x thrust x wheelbase / 2
kqRatio.note: sets the prop torque coefficient kq; tuned for yaw authority in quadmath

tau.source: derive: physicsFromBuild motorTau 0.013 s (B:184) x spoolTauMul 0.73 (QP:489), quadmath's spool-up time constant
tau.note: sets rotor inertia J so the linearised motor lag at hover equals it

tauDownMult.note: parity model only; the physical motor's spool-down follows from its own equation

reverseScale.note: UNMEASURED: quadmath's feel constant, never measured on this quad or bench. It sets the crash flip: at 0.85 the reversed pair lifts 2.1x the weight, the quad launches and spins up in free air to about 2950 deg/s (held there by aeroB/aeroC, also unmeasured); below about 0.41 it stays on its rim and pivots over at 1460-1780 deg/s; at 0.20 it no longer flips (PROGRESS.md 2026-10-26, round 4). To be set from the owner's turtle log (tools/hover-from-log.mjs --turtle): the time to turn over, read by one rule from the log and the sim, whose gyros both clip at 2000 deg/s (tests/gate-plant.mjs X4)

cdAFront.source: derive: CDA_XY0 0.0054 (QP:95) x cdMul 1.578 (QP:492 at floatiness 0.32, QP:111) x userDragMul 1.02 (H:5199, build drag 0.561 from B:185)
cdAFront.note: quadmath tuned these so a 65 mm 90-degree punch lands in 50-70 km/h (QP:93-94); prop plane = body X and Y

cdAPlan.source: derive: CDA_Z0 0.0060 (QP:96) x cdMul 1.578 x userDragMul 1.02, as cdAFront

skinB.source: owner's M4 instruction: quadratic drag, frontal and plan
skinB.note: quadmath also has a linear skin term (QP:97); not part of the M4 model

aeroB.source: derive: aeroCoeffs (QP:205-216) = AERO_B0 3.0e-5 (QP:98) x prop area 1 x aeroBMul 1.578 (QP:493 at floatiness 0.32); added by the owner's decision of 2026-10-23
aeroB.note: quadmath's linear rotational damping, tuned for feel in quadmath; no measured value

aeroC.source: derive: aeroCoeffs (QP:205-216) = AERO_C0 2.2e-6 (QP:99) x prop ref^3 1 x aeroBMul 1.578 (QP:493); added by the owner's decision of 2026-10-23
aeroC.note: quadmath's quadratic rotational damping; no measured value

discK.source: owner's M4 instruction: quadratic drag, frontal and plan
discK.note: quadmath's chopped-disc drag multiplier (QP:100) is not part of the M4 model

groundK.source: derive: whoopGroundK (W:147-151) = 0.062 x groundStr 1 (W:20) x whoopScale(build).ground (W:121), on the preset build; ground effect 1 + k (1 - h/D)^2 (QP:191-197)

capacityMah.source: HV measured.pack: weBLEEDfpv 340 mAh 1S BT2.0, the pack the bench hover was flown on (owner decision 2026-10-23)
capacityMah.note: nominal capacity; no discharge test of this pack

cellIR.source: owner decision 2026-10-23, from the punch log (tests/reference/air65-punch.json): about 0.5 V of sag over 12.5 A logged, x 1.24 (the bench current correction, AJ:44-46, as for iHover) = 32 mOhm; the tool gives 35.4 mOhm on punch 1 and 30.3 mOhm on punch 3 (from hover at 3.0-3.1 A logged to 15.3-15.4 A)
cellIR.note: the hover log (HV) gives 48.3 mOhm at the start of the hover ((4.24 - 4.11) V / ((2.79 - 0.62) A x 1.24)) and 57.0 mOhm at its end ((4.08 - 3.86) V / (3.11 A x 1.24)), at 3 A; the punch's 32 mOhm is over a 12 A step. The pack's effective IR falls with current and rises with discharge; IR against current and state of charge is a Phase 3 item (owner, 2026-10-23)

iHover.source: the motor current at hover: HV measured.amps_mean_a 3.04 A logged less iQuiescent's 0.55 A logged, x 1.24, the Air65 bench's current-sensor correction (AJ:44-46): (3.04 - 0.55) x 1.24 = 3.0876; owner decisions 2026-10-23 (the hover's total 3.77 A until the quiescent current was split out)
iHover.note: pack current = iQuiescent + iHover x (rpm / rpmHover)^currentExponent, a quarter of iHover's term per rotor; a rotor at duty 0 (DShot 0, or DShot 48 under dynamic idle) brakes on its shorted winding and draws nothing (owner decisions 2026-10-23)

ocv.note: a LiPo table; no source tabulates the weBLEEDfpv BT2.0 pack

ocvOverDischarge.unit: V per cell at SoC -0.05, -0.10, -0.15 (357, 374, 391 mAh drawn on 340 mAh)
ocvOverDischarge.source: owner decision 2026-10-26: "OCV(SoC) must hit the Betaflight min cell voltage (3.30 per header) at 340 mAh drawn and fall steeply after, so a punch at 3.2 V stalls"; the pack must reach LAND NOW before 340 mAh and be unable to hover by 380 mAh (tests/node/pack-empty.test.mjs)
ocvOverDischarge.note: shape chosen to meet the owner's bounds, not measured: no discharge test of this pack past its capacity. SoC stops at -0.15 (SC_SOC_FLOOR)

bounceScale.source: derive: whoopScale(build).bounce (W:115), on the preset build (25.4 g: quadmath's normalizeBuild rounds AUW to 0.1 g, B:62)

crashScale.source: derive: whoopScale(build).crashAt (W:116), on the preset build

spinScale.source: derive: whoopScale(build).spin (W:117), on the preset build
spinScale.note: contact spin-kick scale; the physical model's footprint contact takes its spin from the lever arms and does not use it

ductOuterRadius.source: WebFPV configs/airframes.js:64-73 WHOOP_TRUE_DIMS hullR (518846c, read for the fact, not code): a 65 mm whoop's duct is a 33 mm bore, a 1 mm tip gap for a 31 mm prop, plus a 1.6 mm moulded wall; that file checks it against the maker's published 82.6 mm frame
ductOuterRadius.note: the footprint's four duct-rim points sit at wheelbase/2 + this along the arm diagonals (owner decision 2026-10-23); not measured on this Air65

hullBelow.source: owner, 2026-10-29: the CG 10 mm above the duct bottom, estimated from a rim-hang (a string tied at a duct rim hangs the quad at about 25-30 degrees, the CG a few mm above the plate). Equal to the value it replaces, WebFPV configs/airframes.js:64-73 WHOOP_TRUE_DIMS vHalfDown, and to quadmath's FLOOR_CLEARANCE_M 0.01 (QP:90)
hullBelow.note: ESTIMATED, not measured: the owner's rim-hang estimate, no balance or pendulum reading. The duct-rim points' height below the CG and the rest height on the floor; with ductHeight it puts the ducts' top rim 3.25 mm above the CG

hullAbove.source: WebFPV configs/airframes.js:64-73 WHOOP_TRUE_DIMS vHalfUp (18 mm of canopy and camera above the CG)
hullAbove.note: the canopy-top point's height above the CG

rpmHover.source: HV measured.hover_rpm 32359 (owner: 32360), the rotors' rpm at which the pack drew iHover

currentExponent.source: owner decision 2026-10-23 (round 4): refit on the motor current (logged total less 0.55 A) at the five points, idle 5.9 krpm 0.62 A, hover 32.36 krpm 3.04 A (HV), the owner's mid bins 40.1 krpm 4.8 A and 52.9 krpm 9.5 A, the punch 64.4 krpm 15.5 A (the owner's reading of the punch log; tests/reference/air65-punch.json has the plateau at 63,810 rpm and 15.37 A, and its 64-66 krpm band at 64,309 rpm and 15.40 A): least squares in amps through the hover point gives 2.6035 (rms 0.049 A; with the hover point free 2.627); a fit in log space is pulled to 2.20 by the idle point's 0.07 A and misses the punch by 23 %
currentExponent.note: replaces 2.37, the two-point law through the hover and punch totals with no quiescent current; checked against the freestyle log's current in 2 krpm bands and the owner's two points (gate-plant P7)

iQuiescent.source: owner decision 2026-10-23 (round 4): 0.55 A logged x 1.24 (the bench's current correction, AJ:44-46), the owner's value, from the hover log's idle bin before take-off, 0.62 A logged (HV measured.idle_prearm_bin0) at 5.9 krpm (the owner); at currentExponent 2.60 the motors' share there is 0.03 A logged, so the model sits 6.5 % under that bin
iQuiescent.note: the electronics' current (flight controller, receiver, VTX, the ESCs at idle), drawn whenever the plant runs, motors or not

motorDelay.source: owner decision 2026-10-24: the actuator delay stage (a DShot300 frame and the ESC's update, about 2-3 ms on the real quad), off until the owner sets it from the sweep in PROGRESS.md (2026-10-24)
motorDelay.note: whole ticks of the loop (1 ms at 1 kHz), at most 64; 0 leaves the plant bit for bit as before

electricalTau.source: owner decision 2026-10-24: the winding's first-order electrical lag (L/R) between the delay and the rotor's mechanical lag, off until the owner sets it from the sweep in PROGRESS.md (2026-10-24)
electricalTau.note: 0 leaves the plant bit for bit as before

ductHeight.source: owner, 2026-10-29: 13.25 mm, measured with calipers on this Air65
ductHeight.note: the ducts' side (owner decision 2026-10-28): each duct is a tube from its bottom rim, hullBelow under the CG, up this far, so its top rim sits 3.25 mm above the CG; a wall meets the rim that reaches furthest toward it, and both when the quad is level against it. Replaces 14.5 mm, BetaFPV's Air65 frame table as a retailer reproduces it (bzbuas.com, read 2026-10-28)

wallFriction.source: owner decision 2026-10-28: "duct-on-wall coefficient low (~0.2), restitution ~0.3. Hit a wall at 4 m/s at 30 degrees, expect to glance and drop, not stop"
wallFriction.note: Coulomb friction for a box's vertical face against the ducts' sides, the duct rims and the canopy: the friction impulse at a contact is at most this times its normal impulse. Replaces quadmath's velocity scaling on walls (ductHit: 0.82 of the speed along the face kept, 0.55 on a crash, on every tick in contact), which stopped a quad sliding along a wall in a few ticks. The floor, box tops and undersides keep quadmath's response

wallRestitution.note: a box's vertical face sends the speed into it back at this fraction, crash or not (quadmath's ductHit: 0.325 below its crash speed, 0.10 above it); the CONTACT event's crash flag still uses quadmath's crash speed (crashScale)
